summary: The MaintCampus module is part of the HSPnet system, implemented in ASP.NET, providing CRUD operations and user interface for managing campus data. This involves data refreshment, error and warning handling, and user role-based display management.
purpose: To manage campus-related data within the HSPnet environment, including adding, editing, deleting, and viewing campus details.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: If not postback, FillAgencyDropdown and FillDepartmentDropdown are called.
RefreshData is executed and ddAgency is focused on.

workflows.name: Data Refresh
steps: Load Campuses data and bind to gridData.

workflows.name: Grid Command Execution
steps: Execute command based on e.CommandName (Add, Edit, Delete, Reactivate).
Show or hide details in mdlDetails.

business_rules: Screen editability is determined by the user session's role and agency match.
Auto-generated fields should not be modified directly in the designer file.
Dropdown.currentID is used to maintain user session agency consistency.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is set based on user role and department access permissions.
Inactive campuses are determined with hidden field 'txtInactive'.
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields move from designer to code-behind upon member changes.
AlwaysVisibleControlExtenders keep pnlWarning and pnlError panels visible under certain conditions.
ModalPopupExtender handles modal behavior for mdlDetails.
Page messages are processed on render.
exceptions: Non-editable screens hide Add buttons and change 'no data found' messages to reflect read-only state.
If agency or department mismatches occur, dropdown values are reset.
